Writes one cohort to disk in the directory structure flexynesis expects.

Source: R/flexynesis.R
export_flexynesis_data.Rd

Two layouts are supported:

  • "train_test": a train/ and a test/ sub-folder, each with one CSV per omics layer plus clin.csv. This is the layout for a normal training run (--data_path).

  • "flat": clin.csv and the omics CSVs written directly in outdir, with no sub-folders. This is the layout required by inference mode (--data_path_test).

Usage

export_flexynesis_data(
  X_list,
  y,
  outdir,
  layout = c("train_test", "flat"),
  X_list2 = NULL,
  y2 = NULL
)

Arguments

X_list

Named list of omics matrices (samples x features) for this cohort.

y

Data frame of clinical/survival outcome; row names are sample IDs.

outdir

Output directory (created recursively if needed).

layout

One of "train_test" or "flat".

X_list2, y2

Only for layout = "train_test": the second cohort written into test/ (the first goes into train/).

Value

Invisibly the outdir path.

Details

Omics matrices are transposed on write (features as rows, samples as columns), matching the flexynesis input convention. Inputs are therefore expected to be samples-by-features. Sample concordance across layers and y is asserted first to prevent silent patient loss.
